findings.workflow: 13 switched-on workflows (all except Rate Review Tier 2.2/3, Update Customer Sentiment Tier 2.2/3, Review Tow and Unsold Auctions, T1 SM SOA, R+S Reminders)
findings.finding: Rule 'tasks go to the SM even if the facility has an OM' is broken. In each of these workflows the tier branch splits into an 'OM' branch (Operations Manager is known) listed BEFORE the 'SM' branch (Site Manager is known). HubSpot takes the first branch that matches, so any facility with an Operations Manager gets the task assigned to the OM. Affected workflows: R+S - Facility Performance Monitoring and Escalation (3 OM-assigned actions), R+S - BOG Weekly Walkthrough + BOG Performance Status (2), R+S - AI Lien Process (1), Weekly KPI review (3), Weekly calls first 90 days (3), Update Customer Sentiment Ent/T1/T2.1 (3), Send Monthly Marketing Report Owner (3), Rate Review - Execution ENT/T1/T2.1 (3), Playbook Review/Maintenance (1), Month End Call (3), Confirm contacts on facility (3), BOG Oversight Ent and T1 (2), NPS Detractor Recovery Actions (3).
findings.evidence: VERIFIED (config): LIST_BRANCH order, e.g. Rate Review ENT action 11: 'T1 OM' (operations_manager is known) -> step with owner = operations_manager, then 'T1 SM' (site_manager is known). VERIFIED (records): of the 150 tasks created in the Ops queue since 2026-10-06 (all from Send Monthly Marketing Report Owner, run 2026-10-06 10:00), 48 are owned by the company's Operations Manager although the company has a Site Manager (e.g. Packer Storage of Ashland 31950520935: task to Miguel Luzon, SM is Stacey Camp; Fast & EZ - Chandler 42044596899: task to Jason Tierney, SM is Kara Slavens); 102 went to the SM.
findings.why: Ops tasks for Enterprise, Tier 1 and Tier 2 - L1 facilities with an OM go to the OM instead of the SM.
findings.verify: Confirm the rule applies to every tier; if so, the OM branches are the configuration that conflicts with it.

findings.finding: 96 company/workflow pairs (companies that are Live + full management, meet the workflow's own enrollment filter, follow a branch path that ends in a task, and are NOT on list 4291) have never received a task from that workflow, at any date and under any old workflow name. Largest: Send Monthly Marketing Report Owner 34, Review Tow and Unsold Auctions 9, Playbook Review/Maintenance 9, BOG Weekly Walkthrough 7, Month End Call 5, Rate Review Tier 2.2/3 5, Update Customer Sentiment Ent/T1/T2.1 5. A further 83 pairs are companies on list 4291 'Exclude from Ops tasks', which these workflows suppressed until 2026-10-06, so no task is expected for them yet.
findings.evidence: Company properties and list 4291 membership evaluated against each workflow's enrollment filter and branches (VERIFIED config); tasks by workflow name incl. renamed workflows (VERIFIED records). Spot-checked in HubSpot: Hillside Storage (19578446003) and I-78 Self Storage (30378687142) have no task with the workflow's titles. Full list: build.py without --template, sheet Evidence - Missed Enrollments.
findings.why: These facilities may not be getting the recurring Ops work. All these workflows run on an enrollment schedule, so a company that qualified after the last scheduled run will only appear after the next one (INFERENCE).
findings.verify: Check two or three of these companies' workflow history in HubSpot.

findings.finding: On 2026-10-06 the 'Exclude from Ops tasks' suppression (list 4291, 89 companies) was removed from 15 switched-on workflows and 1 switched-off one (Prepare Month End Report); it remains only on the two Rate Review workflows (and on the switched-off OM | RISK, Storage Reach, Prepare Rate Review and Playbook T1 OM). From each workflow's next scheduled run, companies on that list will start receiving these tasks. Send Monthly Marketing Report Owner ran at 10:00 and was edited at 13:24, so its 2026-10-06 run still excluded the list.
findings.evidence: Configuration read at the start of this session vs. now: suppressionFilterBranch contained listId 4291 in 17 switched-on workflows earlier today, in 2 now (revisions dated 2026-10-06 10:43-13:29).
findings.why: Explains the change in who gets tasks from today; consistent with the rule that only Rate Review keeps the exclusion.
findings.verify: Confirm the list members are meant to receive these tasks from now on.

findings.finding: Rule 'subtasks are not linked to the ticket' holds: none of the 23 workflows has created any subtask (at any date), so no subtask is linked to a ticket. The 150 tasks created in the Ops queue since 2026-10-06 have no subtasks.
findings.evidence: Task records: Is Subtask = true count is 0 for all 23 workflows (history incl. old names) and for the queue since 2026-10-06. Subtask settings are not returned by the API.
findings.verify: Re-check after any workflow adds subtasks.

findings.workflow: R+S - Reminders: Respond within 1 day to external emails
findings.finding: This switched-on workflow contains only branches (tier, OM/SM) and a 1-day delay, then loops back to the start when 'SLA not met' (last contacted before yesterday). It has no Create task, notification or edit action, so it does nothing visible.
findings.evidence: VERIFIED (config): actions 1 (list branch), 7 (list branch), 14 (delay 1440 min), 15 (list branch 'SLA not met' -> go to action 1); revision 27, edited 2026-10-06 13:26.
findings.why: If reminders are expected from it, none are being sent or created.
findings.verify: Confirm whether its actions were removed on purpose today.
